records.source: מַֽעֲנֶה־רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר־עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָֽף׃
records.gloss: An answer soft turns back rage, but a word of pain raises anger.
pieces: A gentle reply calms anger, \q but a hurtful word makes tempers flare.

L.1: A soft answer turns back rage, \q but a painful word stirs up anger.

R.1: Answering kindly can calm an angry person. \q But harsh words make people angrier.

decisions.reason: The word (rak) is the "tender" of 4:3. Compare 25:15: "a soft tongue breaks bone".

records.source: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
records.gloss: [The] tongue of wise [people] makes knowledge good, but [the] mouth of fools pours out folly.
pieces: The wise use knowledge well when they speak, \q but fools spout nonsense.

L.2: [The] tongue of [the] wise makes knowledge attractive, \q but [the] mouth of fools pours out folly.

R.2: Wise people know how to share what they know. \q Fools just say foolish things.

decisions.choice: pours out: gushes, like a spring
decisions.reason: The verb (naba) is used of a bubbling spring (18:4). The fool's folly overflows.

records.source: בְּֽכָל־מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים׃
records.gloss: In every place [are the] eyes of YHWH, watching evil [people] and good [people].
pieces: There is no place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does not see; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes watch both the evil and the good.

L.3: [The] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [are] in every place, \q watching [the] evil and [the] good.

R.3: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sees everything everywhere. \q He watches both evil people and good people.

decisions.choice: the eyes of the LORD: he sees everything
decisions.reason: Nothing is hidden from God (5:21; 2 Chronicles 16:9). For the wicked it is a warning, for the good a comfort.

records.source: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃
records.gloss: A healing tongue [is] a tree of life, but perverseness in it [is] a breaking of spirit.
pieces: Kind words are a tree of life, \q but a twisted tongue crushes the spirit.

L.4: A healing tongue [is] a tree of life, \q but twisting in it breaks [the] spirit.

R.4: Kind words help people feel alive. \q But cruel words can break a person's spirit.

decisions.choice: a tree of life: as in 3:18

records.source: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם׃
records.gloss: A fool spurns [the] discipline of his father, but [one] keeping correction is prudent.
pieces: A fool rejects his father's discipline, \q but whoever accepts correction shows good sense.

L.5: A fool spurns {{gender:their|his}} father's discipline, \q but whoever heeds correction is prudent.

R.5: A fool will not listen when his father corrects him. \q A wise person listens.

decisions.choice: a father's discipline: as in 1:8 and 13:1

records.source: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃
records.gloss: [The] house of a righteous [person] [has] great treasure, but in [the] income of a wicked [person] [is] trouble.
pieces: The home of the righteous holds great treasure, \q but the earnings of the wicked bring trouble.

L.6: [In the] house of [the] righteous [is] great treasure, \q but in [the] income of [the] wicked [is] trouble.

R.6: Good people have plenty in their homes. \q But the money of evil people brings them trouble.

decisions.reason: The verb (akar) is the one used of the man who "troubles his household" (11:29; Joshua 7:25).

records.source: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא־כֵֽן׃
records.gloss: [The] lips of wise [people] scatter knowledge, but [the] heart of fools [is] not so.
pieces: The wise spread knowledge with their words, \q but the minds of fools do no such thing.

L.7: [The] lips of [the] wise spread knowledge, \q but [the] heart of fools [is] not so.

R.7: Wise people share what they know. \q Foolish people have nothing worth sharing.

decisions.choice: not so: not right, not steady
decisions.reason: The words (lo ken) may mean "not so" (they do not spread knowledge) or "not right".

records.source: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: [The] sacrifice of wicked [people] [is] an abomination of YHWH, but [the] prayer of upright [people] [is] his delight.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} detests the sacrifices of the wicked, \q but the prayers of the upright are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight.

L.8: [The] sacrifice of [the] wicked [is] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but [the] prayer of [the] upright [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight.

R.8: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates the offerings evil people give. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves to hear good people pray.

decisions.reason: God does not accept worship from those who will not turn from evil (21:27; 28:9; 1 Samuel 15:22; Isaiah 1:11–17).

records.source: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב׃
records.gloss: An abomination of YHWH [is the] way of a wicked [person], but [one] pursuing righteousness he loves.
pieces: The way the wicked live is detestable to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves anyone who strives after righteousness.

L.9: [The] way of [the] wicked [is] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves whoever pursues righteousness.

R.9: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates the way evil people live. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves people who try hard to do what is right.

decisions.reason: The verb (riddef) is used of hunting; righteousness is pursued with effort (21:21).

records.source: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת׃
records.gloss: Discipline [is] bad for [one] forsaking [the] path; [one] hating correction will die.
pieces: Harsh discipline waits for whoever leaves the right path; \q whoever hates correction will die.

L.10: Severe discipline [awaits] whoever forsakes [the] path; \q whoever hates correction will die.

R.10: People who stop doing right will be punished. \q People who hate to be corrected will die.

decisions.reason: Discipline (musar) feels bad (rah) to the one who has left the way.

records.source: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־אָדָֽם׃
records.gloss: Sheol and Abaddon [are] before YHWH; how much more [the] hearts of [the] children of humankind!
pieces: If Sheol and Destruction are in full view of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q how much more are human hearts!

L.11: Sheol and Abaddon [lie open] before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q how much more [the] hearts of [the] {{gender:children|sons}} of humankind!

R.11: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} can see even the world of the dead. \q So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can certainly see what people are thinking.

decisions.reason: Abaddon is another name for the realm of the dead, meaning "destruction" (27:20; Job 26:6). Revelation 9:11 uses it as a name.

decisions.choice: how much more: lesser to greater
decisions.reason: If the depths of the dead are open to God, human hearts surely are (Psalm 139:7–12).
Balanced translates the name; Literal keeps it.

records.source: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב־לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל־חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ׃
records.gloss: A mocker does not love [one] reproving him; to wise [people] he will not go.
pieces: Mockers resent being corrected; \q they will not go to the wise for advice.

L.12: A mocker does not love [the one who] corrects {{gender:them|him}}; \q {{gender:they|he}} will not go to [the] wise.

R.12: People who make fun of others do not like to be corrected. \q They will not ask wise people for advice.

records.source: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת־לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה׃
records.gloss: A glad heart makes good a face, but by sorrow of heart [the] spirit is broken.
pieces: A happy heart lights up the face, \q but heartache crushes the spirit.

L.13: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, \q but by sorrow of heart [the] spirit is crushed.

R.13: When you are happy inside, your face shows it. \q When you are sad inside, you lose hope.

decisions.choice: heart ... face ... spirit: inner and outer
decisions.reason: What is inside shows outside (17:22; 18:14).

records.source: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
records.gloss: A discerning heart seeks knowledge, but [the] mouth of fools feeds on folly.
pieces: A discerning mind looks for knowledge, \q but fools feed on folly.

L.14: [The] heart of [one who] understands seeks knowledge, \q but [the] mouth of fools feeds on folly.

R.14: People who understand want to learn more. \q Fools are happy with foolish talk.

decisions.choice: the mouth, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "the face of fools"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "the mouth".
The verb (raah) is used of animals grazing.

records.source: כָּל־יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב־לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃
records.gloss: All [the] days of [the] afflicted [are] bad, but a good heart [has] a continual feast.
pieces: Every day is hard for the afflicted, \q but a cheerful heart has a constant feast.

L.15: All [the] days of [the] afflicted [are] bad, \q but a good heart [has] a continual feast.

R.15: Life is hard for people who suffer. \q But a happy heart enjoys every day.

decisions.choice: the afflicted ... a good heart: outward trouble against inward cheer
decisions.reason: The saying sets circumstances against attitude: one with a cheerful heart can feast even in hardship.

records.source: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: Better [is] a little with [the] fear of YHWH than great treasure and turmoil with it.
pieces: Better to have little and fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q than great riches with trouble.

L.16: Better [is] a little with [the] fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q than great treasure with turmoil.

R.16: It is better to be poor and honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q than to be rich and have many worries.

decisions.choice: better ... than: what is truly worth more
decisions.reason: A "better than" saying, like verse 17 and 16:8.

records.source: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה־שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה־בֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: Better [is] a portion of vegetables, and love there, than a fattened ox and hatred with it.
pieces: Better a plate of greens where there is love \q than a fattened calf served with hatred.

L.17: Better [is] a dish of vegetables where love [is] \q than a fattened ox and hatred with it.

R.17: It is better to eat a simple meal with people who love you \q than to eat a feast with people who hate you.

decisions.choice: vegetables ... a fattened ox: a poor meal and a rich one
decisions.reason: Meat was for feasts; vegetables were the food of the poor (Daniel 1:12).

records.source: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶךאַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב׃
records.gloss: A man of rage stirs up strife, but [one] long of anger quiets a dispute.
pieces: A hot-tempered person starts fights, \q but one who is patient calms a quarrel.

L.18: A hot-tempered person stirs up strife, \q but [one] slow to anger calms a quarrel.

R.18: People who get angry easily start fights. \q People who are patient stop them.

records.source: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה׃
records.gloss: [The] way of a sluggard [is] like a hedge of thorns, but [the] path of upright [people] [is] built up.
pieces: For the lazy, the road is a thorn hedge, \q but for the upright it is a smooth highway.

L.19: [The] way of [the] sluggard [is] like a hedge of thorns, \q but [the] path of [the] upright [is] a highway.

R.19: Lazy people think everything is too hard, as if their road were blocked by thorns. \q But good people find their road easy.

decisions.choice: built up: a raised, cleared road
decisions.reason: The word (selulah) is a road built up and cleared of obstacles (Isaiah 62:10).

records.source: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: A wise son makes glad a father, but a fool of a man despises his mother.
pieces: A wise son makes his father glad, \q but only a fool would scorn his mother.

L.20: A wise son makes a father glad, \q but a foolish man despises his mother.

R.20: A wise son makes his father happy. \q A foolish son does not respect his mother.

records.source: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶׁר־לָֽכֶת׃
records.gloss: Folly [is] joy to [one] lacking heart, but a person of understanding goes straight.
pieces: Folly delights a person with no sense, \q but someone with understanding keeps to a straight path.

L.21: Folly [is] joy to [one] lacking heart, \q but a person of understanding walks straight.

R.21: Foolish people enjoy being foolish. \q Wise people try to do what is right.

records.source: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם׃
records.gloss: Plans fail without counsel, but with many counselors it stands.
pieces: Plans go wrong for lack of advice, \q but with many advisers they succeed.

L.22: Plans fail without counsel, \q but with many counselors they stand.

R.22: Plans fail when you do not get advice. \q With many advisers, plans work out.

records.source: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה־טּֽוֹב׃
records.gloss: Joy to a person in [the] answer of his mouth, and a word in its time, how good!
pieces: Giving a good answer is a joy, \q and a word at the right time, how good it is!

L.23: A person has joy in {{gender:their|his}} apt answer, \q and a word in its time, how good [it is]!

R.23: It feels good to give the right answer. \q Saying the right thing at the right time is wonderful.

decisions.choice: a word in its time: a timely word
decisions.reason: Compare 25:11, "a word fitly spoken".

records.source: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה׃
records.gloss: A path of life [is] upward for [one] acting wisely, to turn aside from Sheol below.
pieces: For the wise, the road of life climbs upward, \q away from Sheol beneath.

L.24: [The] path of life [leads] upward for [the] prudent, \q to turn [them] aside from Sheol below.

R.24: Wise people take the road that leads up to life. \q It keeps them from going down to the grave.

decisions.choice: upward ... Sheol below: life and death
decisions.reason: Sheol is pictured below (9:18); the way of wisdom leads up, away from it.

records.source: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח׀יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
records.gloss: [The] house of proud [people] YHWH tears down, but he establishes [the] boundary of a widow.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} tears the house of the proud to the ground, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps the widow's boundary stones in place.

L.25: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} tears down [the] house of [the] proud, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sets firm [the] boundary of [the] widow.

R.25: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} destroys the homes of proud people. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} protects the land of widows.

decisions.choice: the widow's boundary: her land, easily stolen
decisions.reason: Boundary stones marked family land. A widow had no one to defend hers, so moving them was a common crime (22:28; 23:10; Deuteronomy 19:14). The LORD defends her.

records.source: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי־נֹֽעַם׃
records.gloss: An abomination of YHWH [are] plans of evil, but pure [are] words of kindness.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} detests evil plans, \q but kind words are pure in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sight.

L.26: Evil plans [are] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but kind words [are] pure.

R.26: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates evil plans. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is pleased with kind words.

decisions.reason: The word (tahor) is the word for ritually clean; here it means acceptable to God.

records.source: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה׃
records.gloss: [One] troubling his house [is one] gaining unjust gain, but [one] hating gifts will live.
pieces: Those greedy for dishonest gain bring trouble on their families, \q but those who hate bribes will live.

L.27: Whoever makes unjust gain troubles {{gender:their|his}} house, \q but whoever hates bribes will live.

R.27: People who get money dishonestly cause trouble for their families. \q People who refuse bribes will live.

decisions.reason: The word (mattanot) is a gift; here a bribe that twists justice (17:23; Exodus 23:8).

records.source: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת׃
records.gloss: [The] heart of a righteous [person] considers to answer, but [the] mouth of wicked [people] pours out evil things.
pieces: The righteous think before they answer, \q but the wicked spew out evil.

L.28: [The] heart of [the] righteous weighs [how] to answer, \q but [the] mouth of [the] wicked pours out evil.

R.28: Good people think before they speak. \q Evil people say bad things without thinking.

decisions.reason: The verb (hagah) of 8:7.

records.source: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃
records.gloss: Far [is] YHWH from wicked [people], but [the] prayer of righteous [people] he hears.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} keeps far from the wicked, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} listens to the prayers of the righteous.

L.29: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] far from [the] wicked, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hears [the] prayer of [the] righteous.

R.29: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is far away from evil people. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hears when good people pray.

decisions.reason: See verse 8.

records.source: מְֽאוֹר־עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח־לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן־עָֽצֶם׃
records.gloss: [The] light of eyes makes glad [the] heart; a good report makes fat [the] bones.
pieces: A bright look brings joy to the heart, \q and good news puts strength in the bones.

L.30: [The] light of [the] eyes gladdens [the] heart; \q good news refreshes [the] bones.

R.30: A friendly face makes you happy. \q Good news makes you feel strong.

decisions.choice: the light of the eyes: a bright face, or a cheerful sight
decisions.reason: It may mean someone's bright face or simply seeing something cheering.

records.source: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַתתּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין׃
records.gloss: An ear hearing [the] correction of life will lodge in [the] midst of wise [people].
pieces: Whoever listens to correction that gives life \q will be at home among the wise.

L.31: [The] ear that listens to life-giving correction \q will lodge among [the] wise.

R.31: If you listen when people correct you, \q you will become one of the wise.

decisions.reason: The verb (lin) means to spend the night or to stay.

records.source: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָרמוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃
records.gloss: [One] ignoring discipline rejects his self, but [one] hearing correction acquires heart.
pieces: Those who ignore discipline despise themselves, \q but those who heed correction gain understanding.

L.32: Whoever ignores discipline despises {{gender:their|his}} own self, \q but whoever listens to correction gains heart.

R.32: If you refuse to be corrected, you hurt yourself. \q If you listen, you become wiser.

decisions.reason: See 8:5.

records.source: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
records.gloss: [The] fear of YHWH [is the] discipline of wisdom, and before honor [is] humility.
pieces: The fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} teaches wisdom, \q and humility comes before honor.

L.33: [The] fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is the] instruction of wisdom, \q and before honor [comes] humility.

R.33: Honoring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with awe teaches you to be wise. \q You must be humble before you can be honored.

decisions.choice: the fear of the LORD ... wisdom: as in 1:7 and 9:10
decisions.reason: The motto of the book. "Before honor, humility" returns in 18:12.
